revision_summary: Three quote-timestamp errors need correction before ship: (1) script_coverage bill_collection section cites customer_quote 'Okay. Sent.' at ts 02:27 \u2014 02:27 is actually where the rep introduces the bill-collection ask; the correct ts for 'Okay. Sent.' is 06:15 (which Stage 3 already correctly uses elsewhere in bill_document_audit \u2014 just needs to be fixed in script_coverage too, or the end_ts/ts fields need to clearly distinguish ask-ts from response-ts). (2) script_coverage appointment_set cites customer_quote 'Three would be good.' at ts 06:53 \u2014 06:53 is where the rep raises scheduling; 'Three would be good.' is actually at 07:40. (3) script_coverage button_up entry cites rep quote 'We do put it for an hour...' at ts 07:47 \u2014 07:47 is where the rep says 'We'll plan to just have our specialist drop by...'; the 'hour' line is at 08:19-08:31. These are all wrong_ts errors (words exist, timestamps mismatched) rather than fabrications, but all three should be corrected on rerun. Additionally: reconsider the cherry_pick_moments email-refresh entry's schema_reference (currently null) \u2014 it fits analysis_directives.tech_friction_handling and should cite it. Soften the 06:46 rep_intent claim that frames the multitasking email-refresh moment as deliberate 'strategic use of momentum' \u2014 transcript shows genuine friction, not clean strategic execution; this should be reframed as ambiguous/reactive with lower confidence. No missed moments rise to a hard requirement, but consider incorporating the customer's initiating question at 08:33 ('should I just call you?') into the micro_trade analysis for a fuller picture of that trust exchange.
